why_agent_cannot: the drop requires a Telegram or Discord account session
what_human_must_do: Go to oneswap.cc/waitlist , which the OneSwap site links under OnePump. Warning onepump.fun is an unrelated Solana memecoin site, and the Telegram username @OnePumpCC belongs to someone offering to sell it. OnePump's official X account is @onepumpcc, linked from the waitlist page.
Enter an email address. The page asks you to "Use a personal inbox".
Add your X handle, which you need for a spot, and a Telegram username if you want.
Open the link sent to your email to confirm. You get a place in the queue and a Citizen Card.

Share your referral link and check in each day to keep your Diamond streak. Don't make extra accounts: "Self-referrals, fake accounts and incentivized sign-ups are not permitted", and "Suspicious clusters of sign-ups may be removed from the line."
Watch the waitlist page and @onepumpcc on X for the quests and the launch.
costs: The waitlist is free. It needs no wallet, deposit or seed phrase, so be wary of any OnePump page that asks for one. You pay with data: the privacy policy lists your "email address, X (Twitter) handle, Telegram handle if provided, display name, referral code used" among what it collects.
